content: Most people live, whether physically, intellectually or morally, in a very restricted circle of their potential being.
author: William James
story:
In 1870, suffering from severe physical illness, panic attacks, and suicidal depression, William James resolved to make an experimental leap of faith: his first act of free will would be to believe in free will. This breakthrough launched American Pragmatism, establishing that truth and belief must be tested by their tangible fruits and practical efficacy in lived human experience.

This timeless reminder speaks to the universal struggle to balance inner truth with outer demands. William James understood that the measure of a meaningful life is not external approval, but the quiet integrity with which we meet each day's encounters.
reflectionPrompt: How can acknowledging your vulnerability help you build deeper self-trust and inner peace?
